mapper.insert: INSERT INTO otps_shop ( id, user_id, shop_name, province, city, detail_address, category, description, avatar_url, contact_name, contact_phone, license_no, license_photo_url, license_expire_date, audit_status, shop_status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{shop.id}, #{shop.userId}, #{shop.shopName}, #{shop.province}, #{shop.city}, #{shop.detailAddress}, #{shop.category}, #{shop.description}, #{shop.avatarUrl}, #{shop.contactName}, #{shop.contactPhone}, #{shop.licenseNo}, #{shop.licensePhotoUrl}, #{shop.licenseExpireDate}, #{shop.auditStatus}, #{shop.shopStatus}, #{shop.createTime}, #{shop.updateTime} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE otps_shop
shop_name = #{shop.shopName},
province = #{shop.province},
city = #{shop.city},
detail_address = #{shop.detailAddress},
category = #{shop.category},
description = #{shop.description},
avatar_url = #{shop.avatarUrl},
contact_name = #{shop.contactName},
contact_phone = #{shop.contactPhone},
license_no = #{shop.licenseNo},
license_photo_url = #{shop.licensePhotoUrl},
license_expire_date = #{shop.licenseExpireDate},
shop_status = #{shop.shopStatus},
update_time = SYSDATE
WHERE id = #{shop.id} AND user_id = #{shop.userId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.user_id, s.shop_name, s.province, s.city, s.detail_address, s.category, d1.enum_name AS category_name, s.description, s.avatar_url, s.contact_name, s.contact_phone, s.license_no, s.license_photo_url, s.license_expire_date, s.audit_status, d2.enum_name AS audit_status_name, s.audit_remark, s.audit_time, s.shop_status, d3.enum_name AS shop_status_name, s.create_time, s.update_time FROM otps_shop s LEFT JOIN otps_dict d1 ON d1.dict_id = 'shop:category' AND d1.enum_code = s.category LEFT JOIN otps_dict d2 ON d2.dict_id = 'shop:audit_status' AND d2.enum_code = s.audit_status LEFT JOIN otps_dict d3 ON d3.dict_id = 'shop:shop_status' AND d3.enum_code = s.shop_status WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT s.id, s.user_id, s.shop_name, s.province, s.city, s.detail_address, s.category, d1.enum_name AS category_name, s.description, s.avatar_url, s.contact_name, s.contact_phone, s.license_no, s.license_photo_url, s.license_expire_date, s.audit_status, d2.enum_name AS audit_status_name, s.audit_remark, s.audit_time, s.shop_status, d3.enum_name AS shop_status_name, s.create_time, s.update_time FROM otps_shop s LEFT JOIN otps_dict d1 ON d1.dict_id = 'shop:category' AND d1.enum_code = s.category LEFT JOIN otps_dict d2 ON d2.dict_id = 'shop:audit_status' AND d2.enum_code = s.audit_status LEFT JOIN otps_dict d3 ON d3.dict_id = 'shop:shop_status' AND d3.enum_code = s.shop_status WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT s.id, s.user_id, s.shop_name, s.province, s.city, s.detail_address, s.category, d1.enum_name AS category_name, s.description, s.avatar_url, s.contact_name, s.contact_phone, s.license_no, s.license_photo_url, s.license_expire_date, s.audit_status, d2.enum_name AS audit_status_name, s.audit_remark, s.audit_time, s.shop_status, d3.enum_name AS shop_status_name, s.create_time, s.update_time FROM otps_shop s LEFT JOIN otps_dict d1 ON d1.dict_id = 'shop:category' AND d1.enum_code = s.category LEFT JOIN otps_dict d2 ON d2.dict_id = 'shop:audit_status' AND d2.enum_code = s.audit_status LEFT JOIN otps_dict d3 ON d3.dict_id = 'shop:shop_status' AND d3.enum_code = s.shop_status WHERE s.audit_status = #{auditStatus} ORDER BY s.create_time DESC
